name: Comparison
grid:
Hello, this spreadsheet used to be a private info dump for me but a lot of people wanted to see my methodology so I made it public, if you have any questions or corrections please send me a DM on Discord at @theaegisrelic.

Note: these HP values are pretty accurate but don't be fooled by the specificity of the numbers you see, they can be off by a few %.
realistically like ~2000 health per fuse, eHP uses Overture scalars
includes final stand, 0.5x EHP due to plate buff
